sharing of information with third parties


for the kids category, devgame uses advertising which is self-hosted, non-targeted, non-personalized, and checked manually. this makes it suitable for age rating. no third parties involved.


except as set forth in this policy, devgame does not share your personal information with any third parties. in the event we offer services or promotions where your information is separately collected and used according to the privacy policy of a third party, we will inform you of that at the time of collection and you may elect not to participate in the service or promotion.


we will share your information with other devgame users as necessary to provide our services. for example, if you post a profile picture, that picture may be available to all other users of our services.


we also may share your information with third parties as required by legal or regulatory obligations; as requested by law enforcement or other government officials in connection with an investigation of fraud, intellectual property infringements, or other activity that is illegal or may expose you or us to legal liability; or as devgame otherwise deems necessary to detect, prevent, or otherwise address fraud, security, technical issues, or other threats to devgame or others.


we may share your information with third party companies that perform services on our behalf, including payment processing, order fulfillment, data analysis, marketing services, email campaigns, hosting services, and customer service. while providing the services for us, these companies may access your personal information, and are required to use it solely as directed by us for the purpose of our requested service.


in conjunction with the running of our games we may partner with a third party to assist us in providing you with our service. we will share the information you provide us through your social network, such as (1) your first and last name; (2) your profile picture or its url; (3) your user identification number of the pertinent social network, which is linked to publicly available information such as name and profile picture; (4) the login email you provide to the pertinent social network upon registration; and (5) game play information with these third parties so they may facilitate the use of our service as well as contact you about other games which may be of interest to you, service notifications and to solicit your feedback and input. if you do not wish to have this information shared please do not use our service. if you wish to no longer have your personal information used by our partners you may contact us at support@devgameou.com and we will facilitate your request to the partner.


we may disclose your information to another entity in connection with, including during negotiations of, an acquisition or merger, sale or transfer of a business unit or assets, bankruptcy proceeding, or as part of any other similar business transfer.


we may use and share with third party advertisers (and other third parties) certain technical information and other non-personal information to show general demographic and preference information among devgame users. we may also allow advertisers to collect technical information and other non-personal information, which they may share with us, through the use of tracking technologies like cookies and web beacons. the information collected may be used to offer you targeted ad-selection and delivery in order to personalize your user experience by increasing the likelihood that advertisements for products and services you see will appeal to you, a practice known as behavioral advertising, and to undertake web analytics (i.e. to analyze traffic and other end user activity to improve your experience). please see the your rights and choices in relation to your personal information section below for more information about opting out of behavioral advertising.


information about our users is an integral part of our business. we share your personal information only as described in this policy.






storage of your personal information


the personal information we collect, as described in this policy, is being stored on servers in the united states and is accessible to our offices in estonia, ukraine and russia. you expressly agree with your personal information being stored and processed in those countries.






data retention


we will keep you information for as long as we need your data to allow you to use the service, though generally no longer than 5 years.






security


we have implemented commercially reasonable technical, physical, managerial and organizational measures designed to secure your personal information from accidental loss and from unauthorized access, use, alteration or disclosure. however, we cannot guarantee that unauthorized third parties will never be able to defeat those measures or use, disclose, or alter your personal information for improper purposes. also please note that email and messaging systems are not considered secure, so we discourage you from sending us personal information through these mediums.


in the event that personal information has been or is compromised as a result of a breach of security, devgame will promptly notify those persons whose personal information has been compromised, in accordance with the notification procedures set forth in this policy, or as otherwise required by applicable law.


to protect your privacy and security, we may take reasonable measures (such as requiring a unique password) to verify your identity before permitting you access to your account or the service. you are responsible to maintain the secrecy of your unique password and account information, and for controlling access to your email communication or interaction through the site or devgame's authorized social networking at all times.






your rights and choices in relation to your personal information


accessing, correcting, or deleting your personal information


devgame takes your privacy seriously and works in a transparent way. in that sense, upon providing sufficient identification (to protect others' privacy), you can request information from us about the personal information we hold in relation to you and you can correct any inaccurate data we hold.


furthermore, you can change or delete any personal information by changing the applicable information found in your devgame account. however, by deleting the entirety of this information your account may become deactivated.
			in certain territories (including the eu), you also have a legal right to ask for a restriction of processing, to object to processing as well as the right to data portability. however, these rights are subject to conditions and may not always be applicable.


you have the right to withdraw your consent, on the basis of which we process your personal information, at any time, by closing your account or otherwise clearly indicating your withdrawal of consent. however, this does not affect our lawful processing based on your consent before this withdrawal.


marketing communications


we may send periodic promotional or informational emails to you. you may opt out of such communications by following the opt-out instructions contained in the e-mail. please note that it may take up to 10 business days for us to process opt-out requests. if you opt-out of receiving emails about recommendations or other information we think may interest you, we may still send you e-mails about your account or any service you have requested or received from us.


push notifications


we may occasionally send you push notifications through our mobile applications to send you game updates, high scores and other service related notifications that may be of importance to you. you may at any time opt out from receiving these types of communications by turning them off at the device level through your settings.


behavioral advertising


users in the united states may opt out of many third-party ad networks. for example, you may go to the digital advertising alliance ("daa") consumer choice page for information about opting out of interest-based advertising and your choices regarding having information used by daa companies. you may also go to the network advertising initiative ("nai") consumer opt-out page information about opting out of interest-based advertising and your choices regarding having information used by nai members. additional information is available on the daa's website at www.aboutads.info or the nai's website at www.networkadvertising.org.


users in the european union may go the european interactive digital advertising alliance ("edaa") your online choices website and select their country to learn more about interest-based advertising and how to opt out in their own country. for example, users in france may go to the controler ses cookieswebsite to opt out of certain third-party ad networks' interest-based advertising and find additional information at www.youronlinechoices.com/fr.


opting out from one or more companies listed on the daa consumer choice page, the nai consumer opt-out page, or through the various edaa websites will opt you out from those companies' delivery of interest-based content or ads to you, but it does not mean you will no longer receive any advertising through our site or app or on other websites. you may continue to receive advertisements, for example, based on the particular website that you are viewing (i.e., contextually based ads). if your browser is configured to reject cookies when you opt out on the daa, nai, and/or edaa websites, your opt out may not be effective. please note that if you use multiple devices you will have to opt out on each individual device.






links to other websites or applications


links from the devgame service to third party websites or applications are provided for your convenience. in addition, content in the service may be hosted by other websites or applications. any personal information you provide on the linked pages or applications is provided directly to that third party and is subject to that third party's privacy policy, not ours. these other websites and applications maintain their own policies regarding cookies and the collection and use of personal information. it is up to you to review those policies yourself.






policy regarding children under the age of 13


the devgame is committed to protecting the privacy of children who use our sites and applications. this children's online privacy policy explains our information collection, disclosure, and parental consent practices with respect to information provided by children under the age of 13 ("child" or "children"), and uses terms that are defined in our general privacy and cookie policy. this policy is in accordance with the u.s. children's online privacy protection act ("coppa"), and outlines our practices in the united states and latin america regarding children's personal information. for more information about coppa and general tips about protecting children's online privacy, please visit onguard online. most of devgame's services are for kids audience and are directed to children under the age of 13. through these services, devgame does not knowingly collect or solicit personal information from anyone under the age of 13 or knowingly allow such persons to access those services.


through other services, however, devgame may be more likely to collect some personal information about children under 13. for such services, devgame will request users' ages and, if a user indicates that s/he is under 13, devgame will only collect personal information, such as persistent identifiers (e.g., ip address and device information), necessary for internal operations of the service. devgame will only use such information to support internal operations of the service and not for other purposes.


if you are under 13, please do not attempt to register an account with any of the services or send any information about yourself to us, including your name, address, telephone number, or email address. in the event that we learn that we have collected personal information other than persistent identifiers used to support internal operations of the services, from a child under the age of 13, we will delete that information as quickly as possible. we recommend that minors over the age of 13 ask their parents or guardians for permission before sending any information about themselves to anyone over the internet.


1. the information we collect from children, how we use it, and how and when we communicate with parents


devgame offers to its users a range of sites and applications, some of which are primarily targeted at children, and others that are intended for users of all ages and their families. our sites and applications offer a variety of activities, including activities that may collect information from children. below we summarize potential instances of collection and outline how and when we will provide parental notice and/or seek parental consent. in any instance that we collect personal information from a child, we will retain that information only so long as reasonably necessary to fulfill the activity request or allow the child to continue to participate in the activity, and ensure the security of our users and our services, or as required by law. in the event we discover we have collected information from a child in a manner inconsistent with coppa's requirements, we will either delete the information or immediately seek the parent's consent for that collection.






registration


children can, in many cases, register with our sites and applications to view content, play games, participate in contests, and engage in special features, among other things. during the registration process, we may ask the child to provide certain information for notification and security purposes, including a parent or guardian's email address, the child's first name and gender, the child's member or account username, and password. we also may ask for birth dates from children to validate their ages. we strongly advise children never to provide any personal information in their usernames. please note that children can choose whether to share their information with us, but certain features cannot function without it. as a result, children may not be able to access certain features if required information has not been provided. we will not require a child to provide more information than is reasonably necessary in order to participate in an online activity.


about the collection of parent email address: consistent with the requirements of coppa, on any child-targeted site or application, or in any instance where we ask for age and determine the user is age 12 or under, we will ask for a parent or guardian email address before we collect any personal information from the child. if you believe your child is participating in an activity that collects personal information and you or another parent/guardian have not received an email providing notice or seeking your consent, please feel free to contact us at support@devgameou.com. we will not use parent emails provided for parental consent purposes to market to the parent, unless the parent has expressly opted in to email marketing or has separately participated in an activity that allows for such email contact.






content generated by a child


certain activities on our sites and applications allow children to create or manipulate content and save it with devgame. some of these activities do not require children to provide any personal information and therefore may not result in notice to the parent or require parental consent. if an activity potentially allows a child to insert personal information in their created content, we will either pre-screen the submission to delete any personal information, or we will seek verifiable parental consent by email for the collection. examples of created content that may include personal information are stories or other open-text fields, and drawings that allow text or free-hand entry of information. if, in addition to collecting content that includes personal information, devgame also plans to post the content publicly or share it with a third party for the third party's own use, we will obtain a higher level of parental consent.






about verifiable parental consent:


email consent. in the event devgame wishes to collect personal information from a child, coppa requires that we first seek a parent or guardian's consent by email. in the email we will explain what information we are collecting, how we plan to use it, how the parent can provide consent, and how the parent can revoke consent. if we do not receive parental consent within a reasonable time, we will delete the parent contact information and any other information collected from the child in connection with that activity.


high-level consent. in the event devgame collects personal information from a child that will be posted publicly, we will seek a higher level of consent than email consent. such "high-level" methods of consent include but are not limited to asking for a credit card or other payment method for verification (with a nominal charge involved), speaking to a trained customer service representative by telephone or video chat, or requiring a signed consent form by mail, email attachment, or fax. after providing high-level consent, a parent may have the opportunity to use a pin or password in future communications as a way to confirm the parent's identity.


teacher consent in lieu of a parent. with regard to school-based activities, coppa allows teachers and school administrators to act in the stead of parents to provide consent for the collection of personal information from children. schools should always notify parents about these activities. for more information on parental rights with respect to a child's educational record under the family educational rights and privacy act (ferpa), please visit the ferpa site.






chat


certain games and activities that are directed to children allow users to communicate directly with other users by means of a chat system. in most cases, these chat systems employ filters that are intended to prevent the communication of both personal information and age-inappropriate words and phrases. in addition to filters, we may employ live moderation and/or encourage other users to flag inappropriate communications. we strongly encourage children who use these interactive features on our sites and applications never to provide personal information about themselves or any third party, and certainly never to attempt to circumvent our filters or moderation. we also recommend that parents carefully supervise their children when the children participate in online activities.


where devgame employs a chat system that does not filter all or nearly all personal information, we will first seek high-level consent from the parent.






contests and sweepstakes


for contests and sweepstakes, we typically require only the information necessary for a child to participate, such as first name (to distinguish among family members) and parent email address (to notify the parent where required by law). we only contact the parent for more personalized information for prize-fulfillment purposes when the child wins the contest or sweepstakes.


of course, some contests and sweepstakes ask the child to submit their own created content along with the child's entry. in those instances, we may require parental consent prior to submission.






email contact with a child


on occasion, in order to respond to a question or request from a child, devgame may need to ask for the child's online contact information, such as an email address. devgame will delete this information immediately after responding to the question or request.


in connection with certain activities or services, we may collect a child's online contact information, such as an email address, in order to communicate with the child more than once. in such instances we will retain the child's online contact information to honor the request and for no other purpose such as marketing. one example would be a newsletter that provides occasional updates about a site, game/activity, television show, personality/character, or feature movie. whenever we collect a child's online contact information for ongoing communications, we will simultaneously require a parent email address in order to notify the parent about the collection and use of the child's information, as well as to provide the parent an opportunity to prevent further contact with the child. on some occasions a child may be engaged in more than one ongoing communication, and a parent may be required to "opt-out" of each communication individually.






push notifications


push notifications are notifications on mobile and other devices that are typically associated with downloaded applications, and which can communicate to the device holder even when the application is not in use. we will require a child to provide a parent email address before the child can receive push notifications from our child-directed applications that collect a device identifier. we will then provide the parent with notice of our contact with the child and will provide the parent the opportunity to prevent further notifications. finally, we will not associate the device identifier with other personal information without contacting the parent to get consent.






geolocation data


if a child-directed devgame site or application collects geolocation information that is specific enough to equate to the collection of a street address, we will first seek parental consent via email.






persistent identifiers


when children interact with us, certain information may automatically be collected, both to make our sites and applications more interesting and useful to children and for various purposes related to our business. examples include the type of computer operating system, the child's ip address or mobile device identifier, the web browser, the frequency with which the child visits various parts of our sites or applications, and information regarding the online or mobile service provider. this information is collected using technologies such as cookies, flash cookies, web beacons, and other unique identifiers. this information may be collected by devgame or by a third party. this data is principally used for internal purposes only, in order to:


provide children with access to features and activities on our sites and applications


customize content and improve our sites and applications


conduct research and analysis to address the performance of our sites and applications


generate anonymous reporting for use by devgame


in the event we collect (or allow others to collect) such information from children on our sites and applications for other purposes, we will notify parents and obtain consent prior to such collection.


2. when information collected from children is available to others


in addition to those rare instances where a child's personal information is posted publicly (after receiving high-level parental consent), we also may share or disclose personal information collected from children in a limited number of instances, including the following:
			
we may share information with our service providers if necessary for them to perform a business, professional, or technology support function for us.


we may disclose personal information if permitted or required by law, for example, in response to a court order or a subpoena. to the extent permitted by applicable law, we also may disclose personal information collected from children (i) in response to a law enforcement or public agency's (including schools or children services) request; (ii) if we believe disclosure may prevent the instigation of a crime, facilitate an investigation related to public safety or protect the safety of a child using our sites or applications; (iii) to protect the security or integrity of our sites, applications, and other technology, as well as the technology of our service providers; or (iv) enable us to take precautions against liability


3. parental choices and controls


at any time, parents can refuse to permit us to collect further personal information from their children in association with a particular account, and can request that we delete from our records the personal information we have collected in connection with that account. please keep in mind that a request to delete records may lead to a termination of an account, membership, or other service.


where a child has registered for a devgame account, we use one method to allow parents to access, change, or delete the personally identifiable information that we have collected from their children: parents can contact us to request access to, change, or delete their child's personal information by sending an email to us at support@devgameou.com a valid request to delete personal information will be accommodated within a reasonable time.






changes to this policy


devgame may amend this policy from time to time. use of information we collect now is subject to the policy in effect at the time such information is used. if we make changes in the way we use personal information, we will notify you by posting an announcement on our service or sending you an email. you are bound by any changes to the policy when you use the service after such changes have been first posted. if you object to any change, your sole recourse shall be to immediately terminate your account and cease using the service.






questions or concerns


if you have any questions or concerns regarding privacy at devgame, please contact our support team at support@devgameou.com.


while we prefer that you contact us in case you have any issue or feel we do not respond adequately to your questions or concerns, please note that you have a right to lodge a complaint with your competent supervisory authority.

														31 games limited privacy policy
													





												 
												





														last updated: november 15, 2024
													





												 
												



													this privacy policy explains how we, as data controllers, process (i.e., collect, record, organize, structure, store, adjust or alter, retrieve, consult, use, disclose, disseminate or otherwise make available, adjust or combine, restrict, erase, or destroy) your personal information, as well as how you can exercise your privacy rights. we are 31 games limited, a developer and publisher of games and mobile game applications, and our products and applications are available through app stores, including the apple app store and google play store. this privacy policy applies to the personal information we collect through our games, mobile applications, and other products (collectively referred to as "services"). by using our services, you agree to be bound by this privacy policy and consent to our processing of information as described herein.
												




 

											





													1. information we collect from you
												







													most of the information we collect about you comes directly from your interactions with our games or with third-party advertisements in our games or other publishers' games. generally, the information we collect about you relates to the type of device you use, information that helps us identify your device, how you play our games, and may include information you voluntarily submit to us when you contact us. we may also collect information from app store platforms, partners, and other third parties, such as information about your interests and in-app purchases (provided that we never receive your payment or credit card information).
												









													the information we may collect about you through our services can be broadly categorized as follows:
												









													(a) information you provide voluntarily
												









													certain parts of our services may require you to voluntarily provide personal information. for example, we may ask you to provide certain information to submit an inquiry to us, such as:
												









														your name, email address, phone number, or other contact information to process your inquiry;
													







														any information you submit to our support team via email.
													









													we will make efforts to explain the personal information we request and the reasons for requesting this information when we ask you to provide personal information.
												









													(b) information we collect automatically
												









													when you use our services, we may also automatically collect certain information from you and/or your device, which may be considered personal information under applicable data protection laws, such as:
												











														data and analytics about your use of our services (e.g., game progress, levels, games played, session length, preferred settings, in-game advertisements you may have viewed, in-game references, or simply game preferences, and how you were referred to use our services).
													







														your ip address and device identifiers, such as your advertising id and device id (for more information, see here: advertising id and device id).
													











													the advertising id refers to the identifier for advertisers (idfa) on apple and the google advertising identifier (gaid). these are unique identifiers for mobile devices used by advertisers to personalize ads. they are consistent across all mobile applications, allowing for cross-app tracking. on apple, you can opt-out by selecting the "limit ad tracking" option in your privacy settings. on google android, you can opt-out by selecting "opt-out of personalized ads." the advertising id is a non-permanent, non-personal identifier that is uniquely associated with your device.
												









													device identifiers/information refers to the type of device, device model, device manufacturer, device operating system and its language, or other technical data (such as screen size or processor), or a combination of these data provided by the device for developers to check compatibility with specific applications.
												







												your device type and operating system used.
											



												your service communications (e.g., in-game emotional signals exchanged with other players).
											



												general geographic location determined based on your ip address (e.g., country or city-level location).
											



												based on your precise address location.
											



												requesting your external storage permissions.
											



												we may collect information such as documents, photos, etc., required for relevant features to facilitate your normal use of product functions. however, we currently do not collect or use other information such as music files, audio files, videos, voice recordings, or other recordings.
											



												when a program crashes, the system automatically generates crash logs. we may collect these logs and analyze them using specialized tools to identify the cause of the crash.
											



												when diagnosing program or system issues, we collect relevant diagnostic data, including system status, application information, device performance, etc. this data will be used to analyze the root cause of the issues and develop appropriate solutions.
											

											some information may be collected through cookies, as further explained under the "cookies" section below.
											





													(c) information we obtain from third-party sources
												









													third-party social networks: google play games services, apple game center, facebook ("third-party social networks"). you may choose to connect to our services through your social media accounts. the specific information we receive from your social media will depend on your social media privacy settings, but generally includes your basic public profile information, such as your username, gender, and friends who play the same game (see also the section below on "third-party social networks").
												



													third-party service providers: we may receive personal information about you from third-party sources. for example, when you install our game and click on an advertisement for the same game before installation, we may obtain your personal information.
												



													advertising partners: we may also receive personal information about you from other third-party sources. for instance, if you click on an advertisement that directs you to one of our services (e.g., an advertisement for our game displayed in another publisher's game), we will obtain information about which advertising network and campaign the installation originated from (see also the section below on "advertising").
												







													(d) no special categories of information
												







												we do not request or intend to collect any "special categories of information," such as personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, or trade union membership, genetic data, biometric data used for the unique identification of natural persons, data concerning health, or data concerning a natural person's sex life or sexual orientation. please exercise caution when sharing such information about yourself (or others) on our forums.
											


 

											





													2. how we use your information
												







												(a) overall
											





												we use the information collected about you/your device to provide you with our services and games and to operate our business. we also use this information to improve our services and games, enhance security, and conduct analysis and research to ensure we provide you with the best experience. additionally, we use your information to promote our services and games within our games and in other publishers' applications, and to show you third-party advertisements. we also use your information for advertising tracking and fraud prevention, as well as to fulfill our legal obligations.
											







													we will use your information for the following purposes:
												









													provide and improve our services: we will use your information to develop, provide, and improve our games and other products, services, and content, customize our products and services, provide game updates, troubleshoot technical issues, understand and analyze trends related to game usage, and manage the games.
												



													display advertisements: we use your information to display advertisements for our games in other publishers' applications and to show third-party advertisements in our games. please refer to the advertising section of this privacy policy for more information.
												



													cross-promotion: we will use your information to cross-promote our games and services, meaning we will promote one of our games while you are playing our other games.
												



													tracking and fraud prevention for advertising purposes: we use your information to track the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns and to identify and prevent fraudulent activities related to those campaigns.
												



													analysis and research: we use your information to understand and analyze trends related to game usage, collect demographic information about our user base, and gather data on the sources of game downloads. we may also create reports and analyses for research or business intelligence purposes, such as tracking potential issues or trends with our games and services or testing new game features and content.
												



													security: we use your information to enhance the security of our games, products, and services.
												



													customer support: we use your information to provide customer support and respond to your inquiries.
												



													our legal obligations: we will use your information when required by law, for example, we will use your country or region for tax reporting purposes.
												




 

											





													(b) in-app purchases
												









													our games support in-app purchases. we do not process payments for in-app purchases and do not have access to your credit card information.
												







													payment transactions for in-app purchases are completed through your app store account, google play account, or amazon.com account in the app stores. any post-purchase processes are controlled by apple, google, and amazon.com stores and are subject to the specific terms of those apple, google, and amazon.com stores. please review the privacy policies and terms of service of your apple, google, and amazon.com stores.
												




 

											





													3. how we share your information
												









													we cannot provide all the services necessary for the successful operation of our games on our own. therefore, we must share the information we collect with third parties in order to develop and provide our services, display advertisements, conduct analysis and research, and measure the effectiveness of our advertising campaigns with our partners. we also reserve the right to disclose your information (including personally identifiable information) as required by law, and to disclose your information in an anonymous and aggregated manner, meaning you cannot be identified from it.
												









													we may share such information with:
												









														our analytics providers:
													



														we use third-party analytics tools (e.g., tapjoy, unity, firebase) to provide our services, conduct analysis and research. the device data we share with these providers is encoded. providers may assign a random id to this data and cannot match it to you. we can aggregate data for benchmarking purposes.
													







														our cloud service providers:
													



														we store the information we collect from you on servers provided by our third-party cloud service providers (such as icloud, google cloud platform).
													







														our tracking and fraud prevention providers:
													



														for some of our games, we use tracking and fraud prevention providers (e.g., appsflyer, tenjin) to measure effectiveness and optimize our advertising campaigns, display advertisements, conduct analysis to improve our services, and for fraud prevention purposes. these providers may use apis and sdks in our games to collect and analyze data and information related to users and devices, such as impressions, clicks, installs, or other advertising campaign performance metrics, as well as in-app events post-installation.
													







														third-party advertising partners:
													



														we have contracted with certain third-party advertising networks to assist us in delivering advertisements to you, allowing us to continue providing games for free or at a low cost.
													







														third-party tracking providers of advertising partners:
													



														we allow our advertising partners to track impressions, clicks, installs, or other advertising campaign performance metrics through their tracking providers to measure the effectiveness of their advertising campaigns. they may use their own third-party tracking providers.
													







														other third-party service providers:
													



														for our games, we use unity software to develop such games. for information on unity's data processing, please refer to unity's privacy policy at 
https://unity3d.com/legal/privacy-policy
. for certain games, we collaborate with third-party development studios to develop such games. these third-party development studios do not have access to your personal information; they can only access aggregated data that cannot be traced back to you.
													









													we may enter into agreements with other partners in the future or replace existing partners to provide any services related to the games. these changes will be updated from time to time or promptly updated when there are significant changes in our data processing practices.
												









													we provide a list of current service providers and partners:

													4. advertising
												









													(a) general
												









													we utilize advertising to fund our services and provide our games for free. we offer our games for free or at a low cost, and to achieve this, we need to share the information collected from you with third-party advertising partners. to protect your privacy, we only temporarily store personal information. the information collected helps us improve our website and games while keeping our games free for a wide audience.
												









													if you are a user in the european economic area (eea), please note:
												









													(1) when you use our games, we rely on our legitimate interests to display advertisements to you. the legal basis for displaying advertisements to eea users is the legitimate interests under article 6(1)(f) of the gdpr, which we have assessed together with our data protection officer. additionally, in accordance with article 28 of the gdpr, data processing agreements have been signed with external ad tech provider networks. we also ensure that our external service providers are committed to a high level of data protection by entering into data protection agreements.
												









													(2) before sharing any information with our advertising partners for personalized advertising, we will always obtain your consent, which is when you press "accept" on the relevant button when loading the game. we only allow our advertising partners to show you personalized advertisements if you press "accept" in the relevant pop-up and agree to share your personal information for personalized advertising. our advertising partners use different technologies to implement personalized advertising, which process your personal information in various ways. therefore, before you consent to personalized advertising when loading the game, please review their data processing practices. a list of our current advertising partners and links to their privacy policies are available for review. the legal basis for displaying personalized advertisements to eea users is consent under article 6(1)(a) of the gdpr. additionally, in accordance with article 28 of the gdpr, we have signed data processing agreements with external ad tech provider networks. we also ensure that our external service providers are committed to a high level of data protection through data protection agreements. the purpose is to improve our games and provide players with more relevant advertisements.you can always choose to withdraw your consent for sharing personal information for personalized advertising purposes. you can withdraw your consent by going to the game settings and clicking the terms and privacy button. in the personalized advertising consent withdrawal section of the privacy policy, you will be able to manage your preferences by selecting the type of advertisements you wish to receive. when you decide to withdraw your consent or choose not to provide your consent, you may still see the same number of advertisements on your mobile device; however, these advertisements may be less relevant as they are not based on your preferred topics, interests, behaviors, demographics, etc. our advertising partners may continue to show you advertisements based on the content of the application you are using.
												









													(b) in-game advertising (i.e., when you view ads within our games)
												









													to enable us to display in-game advertisements, we may send your advertising id and ip address to advertisers (or ad networks) so they can find suitable ads for our games and third-party properties. you can control and limit our use of your advertising id in your device settings. while we cannot control which specific ads are shown in our games (this is managed by ad networks), we do blacklist certain categories of advertisements.
												









													ad networks use advertising ids for various purposes (see the privacy statements of our listed advertising partners), including:
												











														limiting the number of times you see the same ad;
													







														ensuring they interact with real devices rather than “automated” bots;
													







														providing ads that may be relevant to you based on your interactions with other brands and ads, recorded using your advertising id and approximate geographic location. other brands purchase ad space via ad networks or ad exchanges to promote their products within our games. ad networks or ad exchanges act as intermediaries between other game companies and us. to allow ad networks to charge the companies purchasing ads, metrics like ad clicks and potential app installations from other developers are tracked. ad views, click rates, and installation numbers are measured using the advertiser id;
													











														tracking games you have interacted with to promote games of a similar type to you. advertisers typically use ip addresses to approximate your general geographic area (e.g., country, state, and sometimes city level).
													











													(c) viewing our ads on third-party services
												









													we also promote our games in other apps by displaying ads to audiences who may be interested (identified using advertising ids) through ad networks.
												









													ad networks use advertising ids for various purposes (see the privacy statements of our listed advertising partners), including:
												









														measuring the effectiveness of advertisements (e.g., aggregate views, clicks, and installations resulting from ads placed in other publishers’ games);
													







														informing players who haven’t played our game for a long time about new content in the game. we provide a list of these users in the form of advertising ids to ad networks, which then display ads about the new content to these users;
													







														excluding ads from being shown in the game a player is currently playing. we can send a list of active players in the form of advertising ids to ad networks, which then exclude these players from advertisements;
													







														marketing the game to a group of potential players.
													











													(d) who can show you personalized ads?
												







													please refer to the list of advertising providers allowed to show personalized ads and review their data processing practices, including the technologies they use for personalized advertising.
											







													(e) how to disable personalized ads?
												









													in addition to the specific tools provided through the game for eea users, you can also use your device settings:
												









													ios
												







													open the “settings” app on ios, select the “privacy” menu item, and then choose the “advertising” subsection. if you activate the “limit ad tracking” option, we will only take limited measures, such as identifying unique users or combating fraud. in the same menu, you can delete the idfa at any time (“reset advertising id”), which will create a new id that will not be merged with previously collected data.
												









													android
												







													open the “settings” app and select the “google” menu item. depending on your device, this option may not appear in the main menu, but you can use the search function at the top of the “settings” menu to find it. from there, select the “ads” subsection and activate the “opt out of ads personalization” option to prevent profile creation and personalized ads. you can also delete the advertising id at any time in the same menu (“reset advertising id”), which will create a new id that will not be merged with previously collected data.

													please note that third-party social networks are governed by their own privacy policies, terms, and end-user agreements. we are not responsible for the sharing practices or policies of the third parties operating these websites and have no control over them. for further inquiries, please contact us at 
31gamestudio@gmail.com
.
												









													(b) information we may receive when you connect to third-party social networks
												









													the information you allow us to access varies depending on the application and is influenced by the privacy settings you have established on these third-party social networks. you can control these settings and learn more about them through the relevant third-party social network.
												



													when you use the “sign in” feature, we may access and store some or all of the following information, depending on your permission, the third-party social network, and your preferences:
												







													(i) basic information from your public profile, such as your nickname and profile picture;
												







													(ii) login id and/or player identifier string;
												







													(iii) your friends list;
												







													(iv) any additional information detailed in the notification displayed to you during the “sign in with...” process.
												









													we may share your name and game data (such as actions, game progress, and scores) within the applicable application with friends or contacts from your third-party social media network account who have also used the “sign in with...” or “connect to” feature.
												









													the application may also request permission to post information (e.g., status updates) on your behalf to the third-party social network. please note that we will only do this with your explicit permission, and we will store your id and full name for user identification purposes. other information will only be stored within the application on your device to allow it to communicate directly with the third-party social network.
												









													(c) how you share your information on third-party social networks
												









													if you use third-party social networks to participate in game-related activities, such as leaderboards and multiplayer games, you will share your information (e.g., scores, rankings, and achievements) with other players and the third-party social network.
												




 

											





													6. cookies
												







													cookies are small files that may contain an anonymous unique identifier. cookies are sent to your browser by websites and stored on your computer's hard drive.
												





													we use cookies to collect information. you can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. however, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use certain features of our services.
												




 

											





													7. children's privacy
												







													in accordance with applicable laws, we do not knowingly collect or seek personal data from children under the age of 13, nor do we intentionally allow such individuals to use our services. if you are a child, please do not send us any personal data about yourself. if we become aware that we have collected personal data from a child, we will delete that data as soon as possible. if a guardian or parent believes that we may have data from or about a child under 13, please contact us at 
31gamestudio@gmail.com
 so that we can correct the situation.
												




 

											





													8. your rights
												







													if you are an eea user, you have certain rights regarding your personal information and how we process it. some of these rights may be subject to certain exceptions or limitations.
												







													your rights include:
												









														the right to withdraw consent
													



														under article 7(3) of the gdpr (for example, you can withdraw your consent for personalized ads by going to "terms and privacy" in the game settings and following the instructions in the “withdrawal of personalized ads consent” section in the privacy policy, applicable only to eea users).
													







														the right to access your data
													



														under article 15 of the gdpr (for example, you can view what data we have collected and stored about you, and whether this data will be shared or sold. to do this, go to “terms and privacy” in your game settings and follow the instructions in the “request summary of personal data” section of the privacy policy, applicable only to eea users).
													







														the right to rectify your data
													



														under article 16 of the gdpr (you can request that we correct any inaccurate personal data we have collected from you or that you have provided to us. for example, if your email address has changed, you can contact us to update your old email address).
													







														the right to erase your data
													



														under article 17 of the gdpr (for example, if you want us to delete certain data we have stored about you, you can contact us by going to “terms and privacy” in your game settings and following the instructions in the “request deletion of personal data” section of the privacy policy, applicable only to eea users).
													







														the right to restrict processing
													



														of your personal information under article 18 of the gdpr (for example, if you want to restrict processing, you can contact us).
													







														the right to data portability
													



														under article 20 of the gdpr (for example, if you want to upload your data to another service, you can contact us to receive your data).
													







														the right to object
													



														to our processing of your data under article 21 of the gdpr (for example, if you disagree with any user analysis processes described in this privacy policy, you can contact us).
													







														the right to opt-out of “sharing” and “selling” your data
													



														under gdpr regulations (for example, if you do not want your data shared or sold to third parties, please contact us through the contact information in this privacy policy. however, please be aware that such “sharing” and “selling” require your explicit consent, and we do not engage in selling data during the course of providing our services).
													







														the right to file a complaint
													



														with supervisory authorities under article 77(1)(f) of the gdpr (for example, you can directly contact a data protection regulatory body).
													






 

											





													9. general terms
												







													your privacy and security are important to us, and we always pay special attention to ensuring that we process your information legally based on one of the legal bases set forth by the eea data protection laws applicable to eea users. we have appointed a data protection officer to help ensure compliance with eea data protection laws. we store your information for as long as needed to provide our services to you. we may store information for longer periods, but only in a way that cannot be traced back to you. we operate globally and share your information with our partners (please refer to our current list of partners) for the purposes described in the "how we share your information" section above, which may include transferring your personal data outside the european economic area (eea). please check our privacy policy regularly for any changes.
												




 

											





													10. legal basis
												









														contract necessity:
													



														this covers information processed to provide you with the requested (and agreed upon) services, such as providing and improving our services, offering customer support, providing special features in our games (e.g., in-app chat, multiplayer, leaderboards, and other third-party social network features), and delivering in-app purchase content you have made.
													







														legitimate interests:
													



														this covers information processed to pursue our legitimate interests for reasonable purposes, such as ensuring the best experience when using our app, keeping your information secure, and offering our games to you for free or at a low cost. we pay particular attention to your data protection rights, ensuring that they are not overridden by our legitimate interests. we rely on legitimate interests for data processing for purposes such as analysis, tracking and fraud prevention, push notifications, cross-promotion, and contextual advertising.
													







														consent:
													



														if we ask for your consent to use your data for specific purposes, we will make this clear at the time of collection and explain how you can withdraw your consent. we will always seek your consent before sharing any information with our advertising partners for personalized ads or conducting any surveys.
													







														legal obligations:
													



														this covers information processed to comply with legal obligations, such as retaining records for tax purposes.
													






 

											





													11. security
												







													we have implemented appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect the confidentiality, security, and integrity of the information we collect, and to prevent unauthorized access and misuse of the information in violation of this privacy policy. while we make commercially reasonable efforts to ensure that your information remains secure while in our custody, please note that no security measures are perfect or invulnerable.
												




 

											





													12. retention
												







													we will store your information for as long as necessary to provide you with our services. we may store information for longer periods, but only in a way that cannot be traced back to you. once we no longer need the information for the purposes described in this privacy policy, we will delete it immediately, and in any event, no later than five (5) years after your last interaction with all of our games.
												









													in compliance with legal requirements, we will retain your information for the period specified by law. if you request the deletion of your data, we will delete it as outlined in the "your rights" section above.
												




 

											





													13. contact us
												







													if you have any questions or concerns about this privacy policy, please contact us:
												









														for privacy issues, you can contact us via our privacy email to exercise your rights: 
31gamestudio@gmail.com









														data protection officer: if you would like further consultation on related issues, please contact our data protection officer: 31 games limited.
													











													14. supplemental terms - specific jurisdictions
												







												california
											



											if you are a resident of california, the following additional terms apply
											when you use our services:
											



												(a) your rights and choices
											





												depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, as outlined below:
											





													right to know:
												



														you have the right to know what personal information we have collected about you, including the categories and/or specific pieces of personal information, the categories of sources from which we collected this personal information, and whether we share or sell your information to third parties.
												







													data portability:
												



														with certain exceptions, you have the right to request a copy of the personal information we have collected about you.
												







													right to deletion:
												



														you have the right to request the deletion of personal information we have collected about you, with certain exceptions.
												







													right to correct inaccurate information:
												



														you have the right to request the correction of any inaccurate personal information we have stored about you.
												







													right to object:
												



														you have the right to object to how we process your data.
												







													right to opt out of sharing or selling:
												



														although we do not sell your personal information for profit, you have the right to contact us to confirm this situation. we will process your request after verifying your identity.
												







													right to file complaints or appeals:
												



														you have the right to file a complaint directly with us or to the relevant data protection regulatory authorities.
												







													right to non-discrimination:
												



														we will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your rights or choices.
												



											you can exercise these rights by sending a request to 31gamestudio@gmail.com. we will respond to your request based on applicable laws and after proper verification of your identity.
											



												(b) authorized agents
											



											under applicable laws, you may have the right to submit requests through an authorized agent. to designate an authorized agent to exercise your rights on your behalf, please provide evidence that you have granted the agent a power of attorney or written authorization to submit rights requests on your behalf.
											



												(c) protection of minors
											



											if you are a parent or guardian, depending on the state you reside in, you may have the right to exercise certain rights on behalf of your child’s account. for example, you can contact us via the email address we provide to request the deletion of your child's account, download account data, or exercise other rights related to your child’s information.
											



												brazil
											



											if you are a resident of brazil, the following additional terms apply when you use our services:
											



												(a) exercising data protection rights
											



											the brazilian general data protection law (lgpd) grants individuals certain rights regarding their personal data. therefore, we strive to ensure transparency and access control so that users can benefit from these rights. we will respond to and/or fulfill requests to exercise the following rights in accordance with applicable law and the lgpd:
											

											•	confirm whether your data is being processed;
											

											•	access your data;
											

											•	correct incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data;
											

											•	anonymize, block, or delete data;
											

											•	portability of personal data to third parties;
											

											•	object to the processing of your personal data;
											

											•	information about the public and private entities with which we share your data;
											

											•	information about the possibility of refusing to provide personal data and the corresponding consequences of withdrawal (if applicable);
											

											•	withdraw your consent;
											

											•	request analysis of decisions based solely on automated processing of your personal data, which may affect your interests, including decisions related to defining your personal, professional, consumer, or credit status or other personal characteristics.
											



												(b) limitations on your rights
											



											in some cases, we may have legitimate reasons not to comply with certain requests. for example, if there is a risk of disclosing our trade secrets or intellectual property, or if the disclosure could have an adverse impact on our business, we may choose not to disclose certain information. additionally, if maintaining your data is necessary to comply with legal or regulatory obligations, or if such maintenance is required to protect our rights and interests in case of a dispute, we may refuse to comply with a deletion request. if this happens and we cannot comply with your request, we will inform you of the reason we cannot fulfill your request.
											

											if you have any questions about your privacy, your rights, or how to exercise these rights, please contact us using the information in the "contact us" section. we are happy to address any concerns regarding the processing of your personal data.
											



												virginia
											



											under applicable law (vcdpa), you may have certain rights (subject to legal conditions and scope):
											



													right to access:
												



														you have the right to check whether we hold any of your personal information and to request access to or a copy of such data.
												







													right to correct or delete:
												



														you have the right to request the correction or deletion of inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, unnecessary, excessive, or otherwise applicable personal information.
												







													right to limit:
												



														you have the right to request the restriction of the collection, processing, or use of your personal information.
												







													right to object and withdraw consent:
												



														in certain circumstances, you have the right to object to the processing of your personal information or to withdraw previously granted consent, without affecting the legality of processing carried out before the withdrawal.
												







													right to data portability:
												



														you have the right to request your personal information in a portable format, so you can transfer it to another service provider.
												







													right to file a complaint:
												



														you have the right to file a complaint with the relevant authorities. information about the relevant authorities can be found in the appendix for specific regions.
												



											please note that under applicable law (vcdpa), we may take steps to verify your identity before granting you access to information or responding to your rights requests. as permitted by applicable law, we may limit our response to your exercise of the above rights.
